verdict.rationale: Chronicle publishes an API reference. It covers key-based authentication with scopes (including CI keys), idempotent retries, and REST endpoints such as POST /v1/search. Official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go and Rust expose the same resources, so the product can be driven programmatically. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at all candidate paths, which means no machine-readable spec was found; that is a gap, not a contradiction. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, evidence of a full endpoint catalog covering worlds/tasks/evaluations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
